command: llvm-mc -triple=aarch64 -filetype=obj A64-P1-add-register.s -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: Input: `add x0, x1, x2` / `add x5, x6, x7` / `add x0, x1, xzr`. The third pair fixes register number 31 in Rm, which is XZR in this form; it is the widest value the 5-bit field holds, not a register-class check.
source: Arm MRS ADD_64_addsub_shift, fields Rd/Rn/Rm at 0+5, 5+5, 16+5
